selection.policy: Nine requested unresolved groups plus ranked existing queue leads. Count event groups once; aliases/exact derived duplicates are related IDs, not independent events or evidence. admission.reason: No complete proposed historical code interval passed this batch review. Direct identity, naming observations and carrier code-use facts are retained as research evidence; missing allocation boundaries and contradictory mappings are not repaired by continuity inference.
